description: Publish content to a connected social account (LinkedIn, Twitter, etc.). Provide either a saved contentId or raw post text.

accountId.description: Connected social account ID to publish to

content.description: Raw post text to publish directly

contentId.description: ID of saved content to publish

platform.description: Platform name e.g. linkedin, twitter (used when publishing raw content)

title.description: Title for the post when publishing raw content

name: social_publish
